1.consolidated_definition: Delatar a alguien o exponer sus acciones de manera pública. El corrupto se declara culpable y en unos cuantos años saldrá. Clásico. Eso lo sabe el corrupto, que siempre se puede llegar a un arreglo con la fiscalía. Hablar un poco. Tirar al medio a dos o tres. De seguro, el abogado del corrupto es pana de fiscales, jueces prominentes, gente que tira toallazos. (El Nuevo Día, 23-02-16)
1.en_consolidated_definition: To expose or reveal someone's actions publicly, often in a way that implies guilt or wrongdoing. A corrupt individual may confess and be released within a few years. This is a common tactic, as the corrupt person knows they can negotiate with prosecutors. To speak vaguely, to implicate two or three others. It is likely that the corrupt person's lawyer has connections with prominent prosecutors, judges, and other influential individuals who are willing to turn a blind eye.
